critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single continuous dark line on the fuselage side with an array of 12-15 individual rectangular planes. Each plane should have a width-to-height ratio of 3:1, spaced 0.5 units apart along the longitudinal axis. Position these rectangles to follow the curvature of the fuselage cylinder, ensuring they are inset by 0.1 units from the surface to create defined seams.
